mainEntity.name: How is a rideshare accident claim different from a regular car accident claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rideshare accident claims differ significantly from standard car accident claims due to the involvement of a third-party company with distinct insurance policies. Regular car accidents typically involve only the drivers' personal insurance. Rideshare companies like Uber and Lyft have multi-tiered insurance coverage that applies differently depending on whether the driver was offline, en route to pick up a passenger, or actively transporting a passenger. Navigating these complex policies requires specific legal knowledge to ensure you receive fair compensation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rideshare claims involve complex multi-tiered insurance policies from companies like Uber/Lyft, unlike regular car accidents which typically only involve personal insurance.
